2607.15713.title: Map as a Prompt: Learning Multi-Modal Spatial-Signal Foundation Models for Cross-scenario Wireless Localization
2607.15713.paper_summary: Accurate and robust wireless localization is a critical enabler for emerging 5G/6G applications, including autonomous driving, extended reality, and smart manufacturing. Despite its importance, achieving precise localization across diverse environments remains challenging due to the complex nature of wireless signals and their sensitivity to environmental changes. Existing data-driven approaches often suffer from limited generalization capability, requiring extensive labeled data and struggling to adapt to new scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose SigMap, a multimodal foundation model that introduces two key innovations: (1) A cycle-adaptive masking strategy that dynamically adjusts masking patterns based on channel periodicity characteristics to learn robust wireless representations; (2) A novel "map-as-prompt" framework that integrates 3D geographic information through lightweight soft prompts for effective cross-scenario adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple localization tasks while exhibiting strong zero-shot generalization in unseen environments, significantly outperforming both supervised and self-supervised baselines by considerable margins.
2607.15713.paper_summary_zh: 準確且穩健的無線定位是新興的5G/6G應用（包括自動駕駛、擴增實境和智慧製造）的關鍵推動力。儘管其重要性不言而喻，但由於無線信號的複雜性及其對環境變化的敏感性，在各種環境中實現精確定位仍然具有挑戰性。現有的數據驅動方法通常受到有限的泛化能力的困擾，需要大量標記數據，並且在適應新場景時表現不佳。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了SigMap，一種多模態基礎模型，該模型引入了兩項關鍵創新：（1）一種循環自適應掩蔽策略，根據通道週期性特徵動態調整掩蔽模式，以學習穩健的無線表徵；（2）一個新穎的「地圖作為提示」框架，通過輕量級的軟提示整合3D地理信息，以實現有效的跨場景適應。大量實驗表明，我們的模型在多個定位任務中達到了最先進的性能，同時在未見環境中展現出強大的零樣本泛化能力，顯著超越了監督式和自我監督基準的表現。
